name: com.onelobby.unity
description: OneLobby for Unity: lobbies with join codes, WebRTC peer-to-peer data channels, lockstep or raw netcode, text chat and voice, and hosting by IP with a join code (no server). Thin Unity plumbing (UnityTransport, UnityVoiceAudio, OneLobbyRunner) and the drop-in multiplayer menu (OneLobbyMenu) over the engine-agnostic OneLobby.Core, OneLobby.DataChannel (libdatachannel) and OneLobby.Direct.

samples.description: One script with an IMGUI menu: Host, Join by code, send a reliable message, hold V to talk.
The drop-in multiplayer menu: one script, one component on an empty GameObject. Shows "In game" when the host starts; works with --host and --join=<code>.

Players in the world with no player sync of your own: the menu, then one capsule per player that walks and jumps and shows on every screen (OneLobbyNetPlayer and OneLobbyNetPlayerSpawner, built in code). Works with --host --local and --join=127.0.0.1:47810 --local.
No lobby needed: pick a microphone (switches live), watch the level meter, and hear yourself through Opus loopback.
